_comment: Reseller profile for this distribution. Read by tools/partner_profile.py. Human-facing naming (greetings, trial countdown, expiry note) and the trial payment link come from here. notify_emails is EMPTY by default (Corey 2026-09-27): reseller notifications come from True Bearing, not from the AiCIV, so the AiCIV sends, queues and reports nothing to the partner. Put addresses here (or set PARTNER_NOTIFY_EMAILS) only to switch the dormant AiCIV-side feed on for one civ (skill: partner-notifications). Another reseller = replace this file. Remove it for a plain, unbranded AiCIV.
